# Signet Jewelers

We believe love inspires love. And the more love there is in our world, the better it is for all of
us.

## Creating emotional connections. Building loyalty. Inspiring Love.

## The Signet Promise

## Our Signet Promise is designed to Inspire Love and instill trust.

We promise that all our products are responsibly sourced, and we use our scale for good to advance
human rights while helping preserve our planet.

[Learn about our promise][135]

[Our Commitment to Sustainability][136]

The Signet Promise

## Our Mission

Enable all people to Celebrate Life and Express Love. Through innovation, sustainability practices
and new ways of bringing our unique jewelry to the market, we help customers express themselves and
their love for one another.

[Learn About Us][137]

## Driven by Purpose

Our purpose of Inspiring Love is at the heart of everything we do, from empowering our valued team
members, to delighting our customers, to fostering community where we live and serve.

[Our Commitment to People First][138]

## How Much Does a Jewelry Appraisal Cost?

### Why do I need an appraiser?
1. [Insurance requires it.][16]
2. Other jewelers require it.
3. [You want to sell your jewelry.][17]
4. You need an Expert Witness.
5. [Quality Control—Did you buy what you thought you did?][18]

[Learn About Our Services][19]

### Do you offer same-day appraisals?

Yes, but I’d really prefer at least 24 hours notice.

[Schedule Appointment][20]

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

#### Can I wait and watch while you appraise my jewelry?

In a word, yes, and most clients do. The only qualifier is that it takes about 30 minutes apiece to
do the inspection, take the photographs, measure everything, etc. If you’ve got more than a half a
dozen or so items, it’s kind of a long wait. It’s also possible to do some while you wait and come
back to pick up others. It’s all up to you.

#### How long does a jewelry appraisal take?

Each item takes approximately 45 minutes to appraise. The more items, the longer the appraisal.

#### What is an "item" of jewelry?

Yes. An “Item” is any piece of jewelry and may contain, or have set, any number of gemstones.

• Unset or unmounted gemstones are considered one item.
• A pair of earrings is the exception to this rule and considered one item.
• An “item” is any single piece of jewelry. It may contain any number of gemstones.
• An ‘item’ may also be a single *unset* gemstone.

• A “set” is any set of items which can be lost separately, and must valued separately.

#### Do you appraise gold?

Yes! Gold appraisal is an important part of my work. Call or [schedule online][21] if you have any
questions. 

#### Do you offer on-site jewelry appraisals around the world?

Yes. I offer a fully mobile appraisal service and am available around the world. I routinely do work
in banks and peoples homes for chain of custody type reasons or when the client just isn’t
comfortable packing things up and coming to see me in Arvada. I’ve gone as far as Singapore and
Ireland and routinely visit client sites in and around Colorado.  Contact me for pricing and
scheduling, 303 – 223- 4944. 

#### Can you appraise damaged items?

Short answer: Yes.
Call me for an appointment.
303-223-4944

## An excerpt from Our Most Recent Jewelry Education Article

## Why is it So Hard to Sell Lab-Grown Diamonds in 2023?

Have you noticed that it’s getting harder and harder to sell lab-grown diamonds? This is a tale
about how Lab Grown and Natural Diamonds hold their value, with some pointers on how to sell the
former in 2023.

#### What is a Store of Value?

“Store of Value” is an economics term which usually means [‘any commodity or asset that would
normally retain purchasing power into the future.’][22] A house, for example, as well as all land,
generally gains in [value][23] over time. A car, on the other hand, loses value the minute you drive
it off the lot and continues to do so over the lifetime of the vehicle. A house is a good store of
value, a car is not. (Though, ironically, you usually need the car to go to the job to afford the
house.)

One of the selling points of natural diamonds is that they hold their value better than lab grown
equivalents. While that IS true… it is hardly an endorsement.

I’ll start with natural diamonds.

#### Natural Diamonds as a Store of Value

I just did an inspection for a natural diamond that was purchased in 2013 for $8314.00, retail new,
at one of the big and well regarded jewelers in town.

The client is getting a divorce and needs an appraisal of what they can reasonably expect to sell
the piece for in 2023, along with a comparison appraisal of what *they could have* reasonably
expected to sell it for in 2013. The two separate appraisals help divide property in an equitable
way. Lawyer stuff.

The original *seller* ring gave a [‘free appraisal’][24] for $9700.00.  It’s a pretty standard
solitaire ring with a GIA-graded diamond and nothing much else. It was about as mainstream as you
could get..

The client’s expectation was a simple calculation. The original cost of the ring plus ten years
worth of inflation. ($9700 plus inflation for 10 years.) Assuming appreciation at 10%/year, $9700 in
2013 would come to about $25,000 now. Cool!

Unfortunately, that’s not how it works…

internationally recognized strengths in quality, refinement, and master craftsmanship. On this

### News

Her Royal Highness Princess Sirivannavari Nariratana Rajakanya Presides Over the Opening Ceremony of
the 73rd Bangkok Gems & Jewelry Fair

Bangkok, Thailand - On 22 February 2026 at 2:00 p.m., Her Royal Highness Princess Sirivannavari
Nariratana Rajakanya graciously presided over the opening ceremony of the 73rd Bangkok Gems &
Jewelry Fair. The event is organized by the Department of International Trade Promotion (DITP),
Ministry of Commerce, with the Gem and Jewelry Institute of Thailand (Public Organization) or (GIT)
as co-organizer, at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center (QSNCC). The fair is scheduled to
take place from 22–26 February 2026. The opening ceremony was attended by Mrs. Suphajee
Suthumpun, Minister of Commerce; Mr. Vuttikrai Leewiraphan, Permanent Secretary of the Ministry of
Commerce; Ms. Sunanta Kangvalkulkij, Director-General of the Department of International Trade
Promotion; Mr. Sumed Prasongpongchai, Director General of the Gem and Jewelry Institute of Thailand;
along with senior executives from the Ministry of Commerce and representatives from relevant private
sector organizations.  The Bangkok Gems & Jewelry Fair is recognized as one of the
world’s four most important gems and jewelry trade fairs and serves as a key mechanism in
reinforcing Thailand’s position as a major global trading hub for gems and jewelry. The event
provides opportunities for Thai entrepreneurs at all levels to meet and negotiate with international
partners, build business networks and alliances, exchange knowledge, and strengthen the global image
of Thailand’s gems and jewelry industry. It further highlights Thailand’s
internationally recognized strengths in quality, refinement, and master craftsmanship. On this
occasion, Her Royal Highness graciously cut the ceremonial ribbon to officially open the 73rd
Bangkok Gems & Jewelry Fair and visited the special exhibition “TREASURE OF DREAMS:
SIRIVANNAVARI X BEAUTY GEMS.” The exhibition showcases a high jewelry collection designed by
Her Royal Highness and crafted by Thailand’s master artisans. The collection reflects Her
Royal Highness’s commitment to continuing the royal initiative of Her Majesty Queen Sirikit
the Queen Mother in preserving and advancing Thai traditional craftsmanship, with the aim of
promoting Thailand’s gems and jewelry industry on the global stage. The Minister of Commerce
respectfully submitted a brief report stating that Thailand’s gems and jewelry sector plays a
significant role in driving the national economy and consistently ranks among the country’s
top three export industries, generating more than 400 billion baht annually (excluding unwrought
gold). The Ministry of Commerce, through DITP, first organized the Bangkok Gems & Jewelry Fair
in 1983. Since then, the fair has grown significantly and is now internationally recognized as one
of the world’s four leading jewelry trade exhibitions. For the 73rd edition, the exhibition
area has been expanded to cover Halls 1–8 on the G and LG levels, as well as the Plenary Hall
on Level 1. A total of 1,222 companies from Thailand and overseas are participating, occupying 2,794
booths. The event is expected to welcome more than 45,000 visitors from around the world and
generate trade value of no less than 3.5 billion baht. The 73rd Bangkok Gems & Jewelry Fair will
be held from 22–26 February 2026 at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center, Bangkok. For
more information, please visit www.bkkgems.com or facebook.com/Bangkokgemsofficial.

 Over 80 years ago, Carroll Chatham introduced the world to laboratory grown emeralds. By
duplicating the conditions deep within the earth, his laboratory succeeded in growing the finest
gems over the course of a year’s time. A discovery so unique, it remains a carefully guarded
corporate secret to this day. Chatham is now recognized worldwide as the industry leader in luxury
laboratory grown gemstones and diamond jewelry.

What we do

## Our services

### Business Valuation & IFRS Advisory

RICS + ACCA

Independent, audit-defensible valuation conclusions that bridge complex assets and strict regulatory
compliance.

—

**Enterprise & Equity Valuation** — independent valuation of corporate entities, joint ventures, and
closely held investment portfolios

—

**Intangible Asset Valuation (IAS 38)** — appraisal of intellectual property, proprietary
technology, brands, and customer relationships

—

**Transaction Compliance (IFRS 3 & IFRS 13)** — Purchase Price Allocation (PPA) and fair value
anchoring

—

**Balance Sheet Testing (IAS 36 & IFRS 9)** — impairment testing for CGUs, Goodwill, and PPE, plus
financial instruments valuation

—

**AIX & KASE listings** — Independent Valuer's Reports and supporting financial models for debt and
equity capital raising on AIX and KASE.

### Corporate Finance & Deal Advisory

Transactional Expertise

Data-driven financial engineering supporting capital allocation, transactions, and growth decisions.

—

**Institutional-Grade Financial Modeling** — DCF, merger accretion/dilution, LBO, and project
finance models

—

**Scenario Architecture** — stress-testing and sensitivity frameworks for financial resilience

—

**Capital Structure Optimization** — debt, equity, and hybrid financing strategy

—

**M&A Advisory & Execution Support** — buy-side/sell-side feasibility studies and deal-structuring
options

### Real Assets & Infrastructure Advisory

RICS Red Book

Sector-focused valuation and advisory for capital-intensive, physical-asset industries across
Central Asia and EMEA.

—

**Industrial & Physical Asset Appraisals** — manufacturing, commercial property, and industrial
plant valuation

—

**Infrastructure Valuation** — asset appraisals for utility and infrastructure projects

—

**Investment Analysis for Large-Scale Assets** — feasibility and valuation support for
capital-intensive projects

—

**Sector Coverage** — oil & gas midstream, power generation, mining and manufacturing assets

### Fractional CFO & Strategic Finance

ACCA · Retainer-Based

Agile, senior-level financial leadership for investment-backed and growing companies.

—

**Fractional CFO Support** — executive financial strategy without fixed C-suite overhead

—

**Budgeting, Forecasting & Governance** — rolling forecasts, cash flow controls, working capital
optimization

—

**Corporate Restructuring & Consolidation** — multi-jurisdictional structuring, financial
turnarounds

—

**Investor & Lender Readiness** — dashboards, KPIs, and MI packs for institutional capital

## Sedex Certified Jewelry Manufacturer to the SMETA 4-Pillar Standard

DWS Jewellery is audited against the SMETA 4-Pillar standard (Labour, Health & Safety, Environment
and Ethical Business), which impacts what happens at the factory on a daily basis vs. simply being a
formality for audits.

So when an international buyer is sourcing from a factory that has been SMETA 4-Pillar compliant,
then they can be assured that their compliance requirements will also be met and that the factory
would support responsible sourcing, working toward more transparency in their operations and
providing safe working conditions along their supply chain.

### Agreement with RJC (Responsible Jewelry Council)

Adhering to, and following the RJC Code of Practices ensures that our company implements systems to
track the silver, gold & gemstones to establish a systematic method for sourcing ethically,
respecting human rights, providing for the environment and operational transparency. We have clearly
defined supplier compliance and a stronger responsible sourcing story with the use of the RJC Code
of Practices for our gold vermeil and 9K/14K gold demi-fine jewelry.

### Indian Government Recognised Star Export House

DWS Jewellery is a recognised Star Export House by the Government of India. The company has an
exceptional track record in exporting products and developing an efficient quality export process
that has proven successful all over the world. DWS receives the benefits of being a Star Export
House, including faster and more efficient documentation and processing, and more reliable shipment
of goods due to its status as a Star Export House. At DWS, our experienced export team understands,
and is aware of, the international hallmarking Regulations and what is necessary to correctly comply
with the regulations for Jewelry being shipped to customers in all parts of the world.

their systems, and keep operations running smoothly. Whether you're building medical devices,

## **LAB CERTIFICATION**

[Picture]

Our dual-certified gem lab meets and exceeds the minimum gemological equipment requirements set
forth by the AGA and NAJA.

**AGA CERTIFIED GEMOLOGICAL LABORATORY (AGA CGL #59)**
The AGA Certified Gemological Laboratory (CGL) program, founded in 1982, was designed to establish
consistent standards for gemological laboratories and help boost public confidence.  To earn CGL
certification, laboratories must employ qualified gemologists and possess essential equipment for
tasks common in the gem and jewelry industry.  Laboratories undergo annual reviews, with
certification valid for five years, subject to recertification.

**NAJA ACCREDITED GEMOLOGICAL LABORATORY**
NAJA Accredited Gem Lab certification represents the highest standard of excellence among
gemological laboratories, dedicated to upholding ethical and professional practices.  In addition to
meeting educational prerequisites and equipment standards, NAJA Accredited Gem Labs must be overseen
by a Certified NAJA Member.

## **LAB CERTIFICATION**

[Picture]

Our dual-certified gem lab meets and exceeds the minimum gemological equipment requirements set
forth by the AGA and NAJA.

**AGA CERTIFIED GEMOLOGICAL LABORATORY (AGA CGL #59)**
The AGA Certified Gemological Laboratory (CGL) program, founded in 1982, was designed to establish
consistent standards for gemological laboratories and help boost public confidence.  To earn CGL
certification, laboratories must employ qualified gemologists and possess essential equipment for
tasks common in the gem and jewelry industry.  Laboratories undergo annual reviews, with
certification valid for five years, subject to recertification.

**NAJA ACCREDITED GEMOLOGICAL LABORATORY**
NAJA Accredited Gem Lab certification represents the highest standard of excellence among
gemological laboratories, dedicated to upholding ethical and professional practices.  In addition to
meeting educational prerequisites and equipment standards, NAJA Accredited Gem Labs must be overseen
by a Certified NAJA Member.

International Appraisals, Inc. is led by Ronald J. Savill, ASA, MRICS, one of the most              
credentialed and experienced machinery and equipment appraisers in the United States. Accredited

## Jewelry Repair, Resizing & Restoration

At **Jewel-Art Inc**., we specialize in high-quality jewelry repair for rings, necklaces, bracelets,
earrings, and custom pieces. Our expert jewelers restore your jewelry with precision and quick
turnaround.

**Services:**
* **Ring Resizing:** Adjust fit for gold, silver, platinum, and custom rings.
* **Stone Setting:** Secure diamonds and gemstones in prong, bezel, and pave settings.
* **Restoration:** Refine and restore jewelry, including polishing vintage pieces.

## Journey Through Generations

The story of KGK Group began when Shri Keshrimalji Kothari embarked on a journey to Burma, trading
gemstones in India. His dedication and integrity set the foundation for a global presence. Shri
Ghisilalji Kothari expanded the vision, fostering innovation and excellence.

Today, under Mr. Navrattan Kothari, KGK Group has become a premium global brand, with Mr. Sanjay and
Mr. Sandeep Kothari continuing the legacy and the fifth generation, including Mr. Saransh, Mr.
Vedant, and Mr. Arnav, shaping the future.

[DISCOVER MORE][12]

## Businesses

KGK Group stands out with its vertically integrated business model, seamlessly connecting the entire
value chain from mines to retail. As a global leader in diamonds and gemstones, KGK Group provides
exceptional quality to customers worldwide.

KGK Group leads with a vertically integrated model, connecting the entire value

chain from mines to retail, delivering exceptional quality globally.

## Journey Through Generations

The story of KGK Group began when Shri Keshrimalji Kothari embarked on a journey to Burma, trading
gemstones in India. His dedication and integrity set the foundation for a global presence. Shri
Ghisilalji Kothari expanded the vision, fostering innovation and excellence.

Today, under Mr. Navrattan Kothari, KGK Group has become a premium global brand, with Mr. Sanjay and
Mr. Sandeep Kothari continuing the legacy and the fifth generation, including Mr. Saransh, Mr.
Vedant, and Mr. Arnav, shaping the future.

[DISCOVER MORE][12]

## Businesses

KGK Group stands out with its vertically integrated business model, seamlessly connecting the entire
value chain from mines to retail. As a global leader in diamonds and gemstones, KGK Group provides
exceptional quality to customers worldwide.

KGK Group leads with a vertically integrated model, connecting the entire value

chain from mines to retail, delivering exceptional quality globally.

land appraisal values, and tax assessments. The system supports transparency by offering online
access to property maps, tax parcel data, and real estate market trends. With a focus on compliance
and accuracy, the office follows Florida property laws to determine market value, assessed value,
and taxable value for all real estate. Whether you need property value estimates, sales history, or
zoning classification, the Lee County tax office delivers reliable information through its property
information system.

can appeal assessments if they believe values are inaccurate. With services ranging from real estate
appraisal to public records access, the Lee County government services team ensures accountability
and efficiency. Stay informed about key deadlines, such as the March 1 homestead exemption deadline,
to maximize your tax benefits.

### Providing Fair and Accurate Property Valuation

Fair valuation starts with consistent application of state-approved appraisal methods. The Lee
County Property Appraiser uses mass appraisal techniques to evaluate residential, commercial, and
agricultural properties. These methods consider recent sales, construction costs, income potential,
and market conditions. All appraisals follow Florida Statutes Chapter 193, which mandates annual
assessments based on January 1 market values. The office employs licensed appraisers and data
analysts to review neighborhood trends, property characteristics, and economic indicators. This
ensures every home and business receives an objective, defensible valuation.

### Maintaining Parcel Maps and Property Records

Accurate parcel maps are essential for property identification, land use planning, and emergency
response. The Lee County Property Appraiser maintains digital parcel boundaries, easements,
rights-of-way, and ownership details. These records integrate with the county’s Geographic
Information System (GIS), allowing real-time updates and public access. Each parcel receives a
unique identification number used across tax, zoning, and permitting systems. The office
collaborates with surveyors, title companies, and developers to correct boundary disputes and update
subdivisions. All changes undergo legal review before appearing in public records.

The appraiser’s office processes applications year-round but requires submission by March 1 for
current-year benefits. Staff assist residents with documentation, eligibility checks, and appeals if
exemptions are denied.

# Certified Machinery & Equipment and Inventory Appraisals


M&E Appraisal Associates, Inc. (“M&EAA”) provides certified machinery appraisals, equipment
appraisals, medical equipment appraisals and inventory appraisals.

[[Machinery appraisers]][12]

Providing certified machinery appraisals and equipment appraisals, nationwide, since 1990

M&EAA maintains a network of machinery & equipment appraisers who are available to provide services
in all 50 states, as well as Canada, and other international locations.

## Users

M&EAA provides machinery appraisals and equipment appraisals for use by business owners,
corporations, financial institutions, asset based lenders, government agencies, accountants, medical
professionals, attorneys and other legal professionals.

## Purposes

Machinery & equipment appraisals are typically provided for the purpose of asset based lending or
refinance; allocation of purchase price (Fair Value); bankruptcy; condemnation or eminent domain;
corporate conversions and dissolution; divorce; insurance loss settlement; lease end negotiations;
management considerations; mergers, purchases, and sales; and taxation (ad valorem, estate and
gift).

Machinery & equipment appraisals and medical equipment appraisals are completed under numerous value
scenarios, which typically include:
* * **Reproduction Cost New**
  * **Replacement Cost New**
  * **Fair Market Value**
  * **Fair Market Value – In Continued Use**
  * **Fair Market Value – Installed**
  * **Orderly Liquidation Value**
  * **Forced Liquidation Value**
  * **Liquidation Value – In Place**
  * **Salvage Value**
  * **Scrap Value**

Inventory appraisals are typically provided for the purpose of asset based lending or
refinance. Inventory appraisals that are accomplished for secured lenders or are related to a loan
transaction are typically prepared on the basis of Forced Liquidation Value or Orderly Liquidation
Value.

## Expertise

[[Equipment appraisals]][13]

Greg Feinsinger, CMEA – President

Gregory F. Feinsinger (“Greg”) is the president of M&EAA.

Greg is a certified machinery & equipment appraiser (“CMEA”) and has over 25 years of appraisal
experience.

All appraisals are completed in conformance with the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal
Practice (“USPAP”) as established by the Appraisal Foundation.

# Certified Machinery & Equipment and Inventory Appraisals


M&E Appraisal Associates, Inc. (“M&EAA”) provides certified machinery appraisals, equipment
appraisals, medical equipment appraisals and inventory appraisals.

[[Machinery appraisers]][12]

Providing certified machinery appraisals and equipment appraisals, nationwide, since 1990

M&EAA maintains a network of machinery & equipment appraisers who are available to provide services
in all 50 states, as well as Canada, and other international locations.

## Users

M&EAA provides machinery appraisals and equipment appraisals for use by business owners,
corporations, financial institutions, asset based lenders, government agencies, accountants, medical
professionals, attorneys and other legal professionals.

## Purposes

Machinery & equipment appraisals are typically provided for the purpose of asset based lending or
refinance; allocation of purchase price (Fair Value); bankruptcy; condemnation or eminent domain;
corporate conversions and dissolution; divorce; insurance loss settlement; lease end negotiations;
management considerations; mergers, purchases, and sales; and taxation (ad valorem, estate and
gift).

Machinery & equipment appraisals and medical equipment appraisals are completed under numerous value
scenarios, which typically include:
* * **Reproduction Cost New**
  * **Replacement Cost New**
  * **Fair Market Value**
  * **Fair Market Value – In Continued Use**
  * **Fair Market Value – Installed**
  * **Orderly Liquidation Value**
  * **Forced Liquidation Value**
  * **Liquidation Value – In Place**
  * **Salvage Value**
  * **Scrap Value**

Inventory appraisals are typically provided for the purpose of asset based lending or
refinance. Inventory appraisals that are accomplished for secured lenders or are related to a loan
transaction are typically prepared on the basis of Forced Liquidation Value or Orderly Liquidation
Value.

## Expertise

[[Equipment appraisals]][13]

Greg Feinsinger, CMEA – President

Gregory F. Feinsinger (“Greg”) is the president of M&EAA.

Greg is a certified machinery & equipment appraiser (“CMEA”) and has over 25 years of appraisal
experience.

All appraisals are completed in conformance with the Uniform Standards of Professional Appraisal
Practice (“USPAP”) as established by the Appraisal Foundation.

# Welcome Home

# Join The REEDS Family

### Happiness Since 1946 

For over 70 years, we’ve brightened the day for millions of customers with fine jewelry and
watches.  From a gift for Mom to the diamond ring that starts a life journey, REEDS associates get
to work in a job where our mission is selling happiness. Family owned since 1946, REEDS is a true
American success story, having grown from one hometown store to a full-service multi-channel jewelry
retailer, with [retail stores][18] in 13 states, and a leading e-commerce website, [REEDS.com][19].

### Our Commitment

The passion for beautiful jewelry and exquisite service runs deep at REEDS, from our buyers who
scour the world to find just the right merchandise to delight our customers, to finance personnel
going the extra mile to ensure a refund is processed promptly, to our sales team whose vast
knowledge of both products and people can help guide our customers through the most difficult of
purchasing decisions, from engagement rings to that perfect Father's Day present.

### People Are Our Passion

REEDS provides a rigorous professional training program for all associates who will be working with
customers to instill detailed knowledge of gemological factors and a standardized professional and
service-oriented demeanor at all REEDS locations, ensuring customers always receive a courteous and
knowledgeable experience. The entire curriculum forms our REEDS University, and includes a course
from the [Gemological Institute of America][20], which all associates are eligible to study to
advance their expertise in gems.

[ Learn More ][21]

# About REEDS


Discover What Makes Us Best.

# About REEDS


Discover What Makes Us Best.

# From Our Family To YOurs

### Retail Careers

If you’re interested in a career in luxury fashion where your focus is delighting customers, we’d
love to talk to you!  All REEDS associates get started with REEDS University, where you’ll get to
know our company, gain product knowledge, and learn advanced sales techniques.  REEDS is known as
having the most knowledgeable and helpful sales associates in the industry, which is backed by our
graduate level training offerings in partnership with the Gemological Institute of America, the
world’s foremost authority in gemology.

We’re also looking for skilled jewelers and watch technicians.

Giving back is core to REEDS’ philosophy.  Our retail jewelry sales positions can lead to a
substantial income for top sales professionals, and we’re always seeking new ways to reward and
recognize our team.

### Corporate Careers

From our headquarters in coastal [Wilmington][22], North Carolina, we provide all the essential
strategy, management and operations for REEDS Jewelers.  In addition to retail store locations, we
serve customers through the leading jewelry e-commerce site [REEDS.com][23].

We’re looking for innovative, smart and dedicated people who can help us provide excellent customer
experiences, build amazing digital products, communicate our brand, and find new opportunities for
winning in our industry.  Over the past few years we’ve won EMMY, ADDY, and TELLY awards in
film-based advertising, won the Internet with our launch of Bitcoin, and received accolades from ABC
News to the Wall Street Journal for our innovations.  We can’t wait to see what you’ll help us do
next!

Check out our [open positions][24] below, discover all that’s great about our headquarters city of
beautiful Wilmington, NC (in summary:  perfect weather, beaches, historic downtown, the Cape Fear,
culture, sports, dining, and did we mention perfect weather), and feel free to [e-mail us][25] if
you’d be great at REEDS and want to discuss a role other than those posted.

# Join The REEDS Family

### Happiness Since 1946 

For over 70 years, we’ve brightened the day for millions of customers with fine jewelry and
watches.  From a gift for Mom to the diamond ring that starts a life journey, REEDS associates get
to work in a job where our mission is selling happiness. Family owned since 1946, REEDS is a true
American success story, having grown from one hometown store to a full-service multi-channel jewelry
retailer, with [retail stores][18] in 13 states, and a leading e-commerce website, [REEDS.com][19].

### Our Commitment

The passion for beautiful jewelry and exquisite service runs deep at REEDS, from our buyers who
scour the world to find just the right merchandise to delight our customers, to finance personnel
going the extra mile to ensure a refund is processed promptly, to our sales team whose vast
knowledge of both products and people can help guide our customers through the most difficult of
purchasing decisions, from engagement rings to that perfect Father's Day present.

### People Are Our Passion

REEDS provides a rigorous professional training program for all associates who will be working with
customers to instill detailed knowledge of gemological factors and a standardized professional and
service-oriented demeanor at all REEDS locations, ensuring customers always receive a courteous and
knowledgeable experience. The entire curriculum forms our REEDS University, and includes a course
from the [Gemological Institute of America][20], which all associates are eligible to study to
advance their expertise in gems.

[ Learn More ][21]

# From Our Family To YOurs

### Retail Careers

If you’re interested in a career in luxury fashion where your focus is delighting customers, we’d
love to talk to you!  All REEDS associates get started with REEDS University, where you’ll get to
know our company, gain product knowledge, and learn advanced sales techniques.  REEDS is known as
having the most knowledgeable and helpful sales associates in the industry, which is backed by our
graduate level training offerings in partnership with the Gemological Institute of America, the
world’s foremost authority in gemology.

We’re also looking for skilled jewelers and watch technicians.

Giving back is core to REEDS’ philosophy.  Our retail jewelry sales positions can lead to a
substantial income for top sales professionals, and we’re always seeking new ways to reward and
recognize our team.

### Corporate Careers

From our headquarters in coastal [Wilmington][22], North Carolina, we provide all the essential
strategy, management and operations for REEDS Jewelers.  In addition to retail store locations, we
serve customers through the leading jewelry e-commerce site [REEDS.com][23].

We’re looking for innovative, smart and dedicated people who can help us provide excellent customer
experiences, build amazing digital products, communicate our brand, and find new opportunities for
winning in our industry.  Over the past few years we’ve won EMMY, ADDY, and TELLY awards in
film-based advertising, won the Internet with our launch of Bitcoin, and received accolades from ABC
News to the Wall Street Journal for our innovations.  We can’t wait to see what you’ll help us do
next!

Check out our [open positions][24] below, discover all that’s great about our headquarters city of
beautiful Wilmington, NC (in summary:  perfect weather, beaches, historic downtown, the Cape Fear,
culture, sports, dining, and did we mention perfect weather), and feel free to [e-mail us][25] if
you’d be great at REEDS and want to discuss a role other than those posted.

### Our Story

The Rare Gemstone Company has been a leading miner and cutter of fine gemstones since 1974. Based at
the source of one of the world’s most exciting gem producing areas we are in the enviable position
to be able to select out the very best rough crystals as they come out of the mines.

With almost half a century in the industry, in-house cutting center and master cutters, close
connections with mine owners in East Africa and long experience running colored stone mines, we
offer a vertically integrated service from the mine to the end consumer bypassing the established
old chain of distribution and its many built in markups. Our extensive network of miners provide us
with the opportunity to have first viewing and selection of all new strikes and production from the
mines.

### Our Story

The Rare Gemstone Company has been a leading miner and cutter of fine gemstones since 1974. Based at
the source of one of the world’s most exciting gem producing areas we are in the enviable position
to be able to select out the very best rough crystals as they come out of the mines.

With almost half a century in the industry, in-house cutting center and master cutters, close
connections with mine owners in East Africa and long experience running colored stone mines, we
offer a vertically integrated service from the mine to the end consumer bypassing the established
old chain of distribution and its many built in markups. Our extensive network of miners provide us
with the opportunity to have first viewing and selection of all new strikes and production from the
mines.
